---

title: "stats"

description: "Show statistics about the cache"

---



## Usage

```bash
omni cache stats [OPTIONS]
```

---

## Options

### `-p`, `--project`

Filter the cache entries by exact project name. Glob characters are literal; use --project-pattern to match by glob

- **Required:** No

### `--project-pattern`

Filter the cache entries by project names matching this glob. Repeatable, and may be combined with --project

- **Required:** No

### `-t`, `--task`

Filter the cache entries by exact stored (canonical) task name; an alias is not expanded, and a hint suggests the canonical name when one matches. Glob characters are literal; use --task-pattern to match by glob

- **Required:** No

### `--task-pattern`

Filter the cache entries by task names matching this glob. Repeatable, and may be combined with --task

- **Required:** No

### `--dir`

Filter the cache entries by the directory the owning project resides in, accepts glob patterns. Only matches tasks present in the current workspace

- **Required:** No

### `-m`, `--meta`

Filter the cache entries by the task meta configuration, accepts CEL syntax. Only matches tasks present in the current workspace

- **Required:** No

---

## Examples

```bash
omni cache stats [OPTIONS]
```

---
